title: Green Cake
description: This cake isn't really green, it's the frosting that's green and unique.
ingredients: 1 (3.4 ounce) package instant pistachio pudding mix
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps.text: Make cake mix as directed on box except that in the place of water put pineapple juice. Bake according to the cake mix directions and take right from oven and place in freezer. Cake is ready to frost when cool on the bottom to touch.

Mix crushed pineapple, instant pistachio pudding, and whipped topping together with a spoon, do not use an electric mixer. Frost cake and refrigerate for at least one hour. You must keep this cake refrigerated until ready to serve and then also keep any leftovers refrigerated.

nutrition.servingSize: 1 - 9x13 inch cake or 2, 8 or 9 inch round cakes
